hypothesis: The remaining COLD roster scan cost at the #2879+#2882 settled heads (~44ms/1000, ~207ms/4096 sessions, row-oracle-identical to the merged records) decomposes into: a typed-parse floor that still materializes owned strings (type/id/timestamp per line) and Value trees (message role/provider/model/timestamp, name/state/provider/modelId/thinkingLevel) the fold reads once or discards; a per-line Vec allocation (capacity line.len()+17) inside advance_tail that keeps only 16 bytes; and a syscall side that opens every file TWICE (the bounded header gate's open+read+close, then the fold's open), stats every file ~5x, and eagerly stats the mtime the modified-fallback chain almost never reads. All three are removable without changing a row byte.
approach: Baseline-first decomposition on the pinned base 4d57eb082 (the then-current origin/rust tip; territory files verified unchanged vs 4ed68f6e9 where the census source was read): (A) a diagnostic census example (untracked, VM-only) over the real fixture (100/1000/4096 tiers, 177,798 lines): per-tier parse-only floors for the current owned struct, a scalar-Cow variant, the full-borrow candidate, serde IgnoredAny (the irreducible JSON-walk floor) and a full Value parse; IO-only and open+fstat-only loops over the fold's own 64KiB read loop; advance_tail Vec-vs-in-place micro; role-read micro; a cur-vs-bor differential over every line (parse acceptance both directions, every fold-read field, per-file fold states) plus line/byte/escape census. (B) strace -cf syscall census on one cold pass at 1000 sessions, base vs candidate. (C) the candidate: commit 1 borrows the entry (Cow scalars + raw-span object fields with parse-at-use reads preserving Value::as_str/as_u64 semantics and the model_change abort arm verbatim; advance_tail in-place with a rolling-reference lockstep test; a 38-row raw-JSON shape matrix test pinning every borrowed read to the full-parse read, acceptance analysis for the rows the typed parse rejects, and end-to-end fold-level differential vs the legacy full-parse reference); commit 2 shares one open between the gate and the fold (with the TOCTOU narrowing disclosed in the doc comment: the double-open judged one file and folded another if a replace raced between opens; the shared handle pins both to the same inode) and reads the listing stat lazily (only when the modified fallback chain reaches it; the existing fallback tests pin every arm of the chain).
parity_notes: Row/wire parity: every arm, slot, and pass produced the identical oracle (legacy checksums 762089/893085/4336641 and row sha256 ccc76960.../8f41e882.../40258404... at 100/1000/4096) across the 3-arm ABBA (18 probe runs), the settled-head pair (18 probe runs), and the baseline (same B binary). The census differential ran the current-vs-borrowed acceptance/field/fold-state comparison over all 177,798 real lines with ZERO divergence in either direction (escaped type/id/timestamp counts 0; roles all strings; 0 non-string text blocks). Borrow semantics are Value-identical by construction: Cow<str> accepts any JSON string (owned fallback when escaped - the same rows the owned String accepted), raw spans accept any JSON shape exactly as Option<Value> did, and raw_string/raw_u64 return None for non-string/non-number spans exactly where Value::as_str/as_u64 returned None; the model_change abort arm keeps its exact two-step None (absent OR non-string aborts). The in-place advance_tail produces byte-identical windows (rolling-reference lockstep test across keep-cut/short-roll/empty/multibyte regimes). The single-open TOCTOU NARROWING is disclosed: previously the gate judged file A and the fold could open a replacement B that landed in between; now both judge/fold the same inode - strictly closer to the writer model, disclosed for reviewer scrutiny. The lazy mtime only defers the stat the modified-fallback chain reads: or_else keeps the chain order (last_activity >0, then header timestamp, then mtime) and the existing fallback tests (message-timestamps-win, impossible-calendar-date, epoch-zero) pin every arm. SessionInfo rows, JSONL bytes, wire/API, replay, streaming catalog, resume/torn-tail semantics untouched; the fold is stack-local. Fixture integrity: perf-many-sessions-real.tar.gz verified against its manifest (1099/1100 rows clean; the ONE mismatch is the documented stale-manifest row 100/01a0dad3 whose tar bytes hash 39fca708... exactly as both merged catalog lanes documented); 4096 tier = the shipped perf-many-sessions-4096.tar.gz (4081/4096 files byte-match 1000-tier files, 15 unique); aggregate sha256 over all 5196 files 0acfd4a8... (hash method: sorted per-tier byte concatenation).
